description: Publish the exact list the owner reviewed, after they explicitly agree to that summary in this conversation. Never on an earlier general instruction like 'publish when done'. If anything changed since the review, nothing is published and a fresh review comes back to show them.

handle.description: Only when the review showed an unconfirmed handle: the same handle, after the owner confirms it's theirs to show publicly.

name: confirm_publication
title: Publish a reviewed list
